_note: Catalogue of the room items added in v3 (42 floor, 18 wall, 24 desk-top). economy.js registers these ids (price, layer, size, flags) and public/js/items.js draws them. Prices use the ladder 10/25/60/100/250 Beans. size = [w,h] tiles for floor items, [w,1] wall cells for wall items; desk-top items use the small footprint unless noted. Flags: anim = has an idle animation, desk = worker desk (surface top), flat = rug layer others can stand on, host = has a top surface (shelf/table).
